{{Top|leg}}

A '''micro-injector''' was a small medical device designed to administer various fluids into an individual's body.<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>

In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Drikall Bessarah]], the assigned [[Medic/Legends|medic]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], used a micro-injector to administer a pain suppressor and a shock blocker into the neck of fellow Wraith [[Bhindi Drayson]] after she was shot in the abdomen during the [[Siege of Mount Lyss Meteorological station|siege]] of the [[Mount Lyss Meteorological Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]].<ref name="MK" />
